Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Sound Barrier
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Presence/Melpominee
Cost: 2 blood
Reduce a bleed against you by 4.
[mel] Only usable when a minion bleeds you for more than X, where X is his or her blood or life total. The action ends (unsuccessfully).
[MEL] As [mel] above, and the acting minion takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage.

It could be changed to an action (put this card in play. Whenever.... and burn this card).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
In my opinion on  level this is way too strong. 2 blood to prevent 4 pool damage in inferior for a discipline which is focused on other things (and does them well) is just too good. 2 blood for 2 pool would be still worth to play, yet not worth to include in the deck is where I'd see a proper power level for an outferior discipline...

Sabbat. If this vampire's bleed is successful, he laughs manicly and untaps.

Messages.Author: SLave
Messages.Body: Aye. Yet, if we remove the outferior, and decrease the cost by one, we get a pretty nice card, which adds to a clan with no bleed defence.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Reducing the cost wouldn't fit the current Melpominee cards (check Virtuosa for instance).
Currently, Daughters don't have any bleed defense. They are forced to rely
1/ on bloat if playing votes
2/ on Ventrue sidekicks for deflection
3/ on Toreador sidekicks for Telepathic Misdirection (but they are scarce)

A bleed defense card in MEL shouldn't be as easy aa Deflection for instance. Player should be given the choice to either rely on Daughters (but at an expensive blood cost) or the previous options.

effect could be changed to:

Only usable when an ally is acting. The action ends (unsuccesfully).
Reduce a bleed against you by 2.

or something else.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: SLave
Messages.Body:
Reductions for Presence are what we do not require. Instantaneous Transformation is a very good example of a card which, in stead of helping !Gangrels, helped the Unnamed. And the Unnamed required no help whatsoever. Allowing Presence bleed reduction would result in Sound Barrier being thrown into decks having nothing to do with Daughters. And this should be avoided.

The ally outferior might be worth giving it a go, though. An honest cost for the effect, and a useful one.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Name: Sound Barrier
> Cardtype: Reaction
> Discipline: Presence/Melpominee

> Reduce a bleed against you by 4.
> [mel] Only usable when a minion bleeds you for more than X, where X is his or her blood or life total. The action ends (unsuccessfully).
> [MEL] As [mel] above, and the acting minion takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage.
>
> It could be changed to an action (put this card in play. Whenever.... and burn this card).
>
The outferior, as others have said, seems a little bit over the top.

Leaving that aside, the card fits with my standard gripe about many of the bleed defence cards in the game at the moment - they punish the occasional big bleeder, while letting the swarm weenie bleeder or consistent stealth bleeder get off much more lightly. Perhaps, instead, something like:

a) a card put in play which gives -1 bleed to vampires below X capacity, with a limited duration

b) a card put in play with some counters (based on the number of DoC you control?) where you can burn up to 2 per bleed action to reduce the bleed against you, with extra counters at superior

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Sound Barrier (Aranthebes version)
Action
2 blood
[mel] Put this card on the acting Daughter of Cacophony. Younger minions and allies have -1 bleed while this vampire is ready. Burn this card if this vampire is sent to torpor.
[MEL] As above and no bleed against you will resolve for more than X pool where X is the acting minion's capacity.

Sound Barrier (Ruins of Charizel Version)
Action
A Methuselah may control one copy of Sound Barrier.
[mel] Put this card in play or put 1 counter onto a copy of Sound Barrier in play. You may burn counters from this card instead of pool during another Methuselah's bleed or political actions.
[MEL] As above or put 2 counters on a copy in play and untap.
